These voters who are thus designated will be required to show an ID and fill out a residence form before they can vote in a town meeting or any election. ... ## 2026 State Primary Results for Savoy # Town Clerk ## Valerie Reiner Town Clerk Phone: (413) 743-4290 x 1006 Email: townclerk@townofsavoy.com (savoytownclerk@gmail.com) Office Hours: Tuesday 11:00 AM - 1:00 PM; or by appointment ### 2026 Census Notice All Savoy Residences will soon be receiving the annual street listing/census by mail.  Per Massachusetts state law (Massachusetts General Laws, Ch. 51, Sec. 4), these must be returned to the Town Clerk by January 31, 2026.  Failure to return the street listing/census will result in all voters at the residence being designated as inactive, which can then lead to removal from the voter rolls.  If you do not receive a street listing/census please contact me at 413-743-4290 ext. 1006 or at townclerk@townofsavoy.com.   The completed street listings/census may be returned in person at the Town Office during office hours, in the "Town Clerk" lockbox on the porch of the Town Offices, or send by mail to: Town Clerk 720 Main Road Savoy, MA  01256 #### Town Clerk Posted: June 18, 2026 180 Residents in Savoy will be receiving a letter shortly telling them that they are now designated as inactive voters due to a failure to return their Annual Street Listing, as required by law.  These voters who are thus designated will be required to show an ID and fill out a residence form before they can vote in a town meeting or any election.  Returning the signed postcard enclosed in the letter will make the voter active again.
